title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Spearmint Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Spearmint Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a crisp, clean mint flavour with cool, herbal character. Smoother and more fragrant than traditional menthol, the Spearmint flavour offers a bright, gently sweet minty profile with a softly refreshing exhale. It’s an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy a clean, cooling vape with a mellow edge. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and designed exclusively for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods lock in magnetically and work with the twist-to-switch dual pod system, making flavour pairing fast and fuss-free. With two pods per pack, Spearmint pairs beautifully with fruity or citrus flavours, or works well as a standalone mint refresh.
